section1.title: 1. What data is collected
section1.text: Only the TED video URL you enter for summarization. The service does not require registration and does not request personal data.

section2.title: 2. How data is used
section2.text: The URL is used to obtain the video transcript and generate a summary. Data is not stored after processing.

section3.title: 3. Data transfer
section3.text: Data is not transferred to third parties. The transcript is obtained directly from the official TED.com website.

errorPage.title: 404 — Page not found
errorPage.text: The requested page does not exist or has been moved.
